description.subtitle: Water thermal bottle Runbott of FC Barcelona 600 ml - navy blue
description.tagline: The Barça, more than a club in your hydration
description.intro: The 600 ml Runbott FC Barcelona thermos connects sport functionality with pride Barça. With double wall insulation and official design with the motto "MORE A CLUB", it is the ideal accessory for your daily days.
key_benefits: Blue-grain identity: shield and motto "MORE A CLUB" laser engravings.
Versatile capacity: 600 ml, ideal size for workouts or daily use.
Keeps the temperature: double wall with air insulation for cold or hot drinks.
Authentic taste: ceramic coating that maintains the original taste of your drink.
Base antideslizante: goma inferior que evita desplazamientos.
Durability and hygiene: stainless steel resistant to corrosion and bacteria.
Sostenibilidad: 100% reutilizable y respetuoso con el medio ambiente.
